reviews.author: Sara

reviews.title: Absolutely awesome clarity, vibrant colors, shadow boost (for FPS games), love this monitor!
reviews.comment: Uh, so I didn't know what an upgrade this would be from my previous 10+ year old 720p monitor but WOW. My games look completely different. I see details I didn't even know existed lol! This is such a great monitor for the price point. Great refresh time, no lag, vibrant colors. I love the ASUS widget as well so you can quickly change the display settings based on the type of game you're playing. The packaging was great, fast delivery from the seller, no tools required to put it together, cable management built into the base of the monitor. 10/10 I highly recommend this monitor for casual and competitive gamers alike!
reviews.author: Benja

reviews.title: Top quality Asus
reviews.comment: Amazing monitor and Amazon delivery. This is the best monitor I’ve ever owned so many settings but besdides that it’s the perfect size and the clarity is breathtaking. Coming from 1080p the 1440p is so sharp and bright on this screen I can never go back. Talking about the delivery quick Amazon made sure this was secure it was completely sealed in a styrofoam box and then that’s covered in plastic are bags inside a box that was tightly fit there was no way this thing would break during shipping unless they chucked it off a skyscraper
